the_downward_moves.note: none of these shares code with anything changed this round. They are the noise the session measured directly: click-color with unchanged code gave 10/12, 7/12, 6/12.

the_measurement_and_why_it_reads_flat.conclusion: Six families fixed, worth about +14 trials = +5 pp. Measured +0.37 pp because seven unaffected tasks each lost a trial. At 130x3 the resolution is 9.19 pp; a +5 pp change is inside it. THE INSTRUMENT, NOT THE WORK, IS THE LIMIT.

the_four_defects_in_phone_book.1_scope_answered_about_a_neighbour: one contact per page behind a pager; asked for Domingas address the resolver matched a block by area, found SOMEONE ELSEs address and returned RESOLVED. Same class as r155. An absent anchor now refuses.
the_four_defects_in_phone_book.2_anchor_regex_case_sensitive: 'Find Dominga ...' has a capital F; the pattern was lowercase with no re.I. One character.
the_four_defects_in_phone_book.3_paginated_list_is_searched_by_turning_: walking '>' found Marielle after three advances; now bounded at 40 advances
the_four_defects_in_phone_book.4_a_point_is_not_an_element: phone-book computes `expectedDetails.property === this.getAttribute('class')` -- it reads `this`. A mouse event at a coordinate gives the handler an element via hit-testing, but a resolver that returns a POINT cannot guarantee which element. click_el(dom=True) dispatches click() on the matched element and the SCOPE choice now carries a selector built from the page class names.

verified_manually_end_to_end: phone-book: page to the name -> querySelector('a.phone').click() -> reward 1. The mechanism is correct; the resolver wires it on 2 of 8 reps.
